look: Grit Imp, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Ruin Gargoyles family: pebble-skinned grinning imp holding a handful of gravel. Family anatomy: stone gargoyles and imps with bat wings, horns and pebbled stone skin. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are slate-grey grit crystal. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, small subtle stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
